newsitem.title: CYPRUS: First snow in 14 years blankets Cyprus capital.
newsitem.headline: First snow in 14 years blankets Cyprus capital.

text.p: Residents of Nicosia, used to almost year-round sunshine, woke up on Tuesday to find the eastern Mediterranean island capital blanketed in snow.
"The last time we had snowfall in Nicosia was in 1983," said Kleanthis Philaniotis, director of the Cyprus Metereological Department.
Snow also fell in the southeastern coastal areas of Larnaca and Famagusta. "This is very infrequent. It might happen once every 20 or 30 years," he said.
